properties.content: Question: terex disease symptoms Answer: Tourette syndrome (TS) is a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by repetitive, sudden, and involuntary movements or vocalizations called tics. Common Symptoms of Tourette Syndrome: Motor Tics:: Eye blinking, Head jerking, Shoulder shrugging, Nose twitching, Arm or leg jerking, and Facial grimacing. Vocal Tics:: - Throat clearing - Grunting - Barking - Sniffing - Whistling - Repeating words or phrases (echolalia) - Saying obscene words (coprolalia) Other Symptoms: Difficulty concentrating, Hyperactivity, Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), Anxiety, and Sleep disturbances. Note: The severity and frequency of tics can vary widely among individuals. Some people may experience only mild tics, while others may have more severe symptoms that interfere with their daily lives.
properties.formattedContent:
Question: terex disease symptoms

Answer: Tourette syndrome (TS) is a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by repetitive, sudden, and involuntary movements or vocalizations called tics.
Common Symptoms of Tourette Syndrome:
Motor Tics::
Eye blinking, Head jerking, Shoulder shrugging, Nose twitching, Arm or leg jerking, and Facial grimacing.
Vocal Tics::
- Throat clearing
- Grunting
- Barking
- Sniffing
- Whistling
- Repeating words or phrases (echolalia)
- Saying obscene words (coprolalia)
Other Symptoms: Difficulty concentrating, Hyperactivity, Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), Anxiety, and Sleep disturbances.
Note: The severity and frequency of tics can vary widely among individuals. Some people may experience only mild tics, while others may have more severe symptoms that interfere with their daily lives.
